# WebSocket sub-actions

## Client: connect / disconnect

Connects Cuebot to another program over a WebSocket, or ends that connection.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Client** | Which client: its name, or its number in your list (0 is the first). |
| **State** | Connect opens the connection, Disconnect closes it. Options: Connect, Disconnect. Starts as: `Connect`. |

<small>Type id: `websocket.clientState`</small>

## Client: send message

Sends a message to another program over a WebSocket connection Cuebot has made. Fails if the connection is not open.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Client** | Which client: its name, or its number in your list (0 is the first). |
| **Message** | The text to send. |

<small>Type id: `websocket.clientSend`</small>

## Custom server: send message

Sends a message to programs connected to one of your own WebSocket servers (an open line to another app). Use it to talk to your own tools.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Server** | Which server: its name, or its number in your list (0 is the first). |
| **Message** | The text to send. |
| **Session id** | Send to just one connected program: type its session id. Leave empty to send to all. In a message trigger, %sessionId% answers whoever wrote. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%sentCount%` | How many programs got the message |

<small>Type id: `websocket.serverSend`</small>

## Custom server: start / stop

Starts or stops one of your own WebSocket servers (the open line other programs connect to).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Server** | Which server: its name, or its number in your list (0 is the first). |
| **State** | Start opens the server, Stop closes it. Options: Start, Stop. Starts as: `Start`. |

<small>Type id: `websocket.serverState`</small>

## WebSocket server: broadcast

Sends a message to every program connected to Cuebot's built-in WebSocket address (the one other apps use to talk to Cuebot).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Message** | The text to send. If it is written as JSON it is sent as data, otherwise as plain text. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%sentCount%` | How many programs got the message |

<small>Type id: `websocket.broadcast`</small>
